stemAssignment.source: No CP02 assignment exists for CIN_011; quiet_discovery music + wind_canopy ambience are the quiet-workshop cues (composed, CP26/CP30) for this carving-workshop scene (S01: a workbench with carved tablets -- handprint and tally-mark motifs -- and carving tools (hammer, chisels, brushes), DETAIL_LOCKED; S02: two men in an open bamboo shelter, the younger handing a small bowl to the older bearded man, lanterns, baskets and pots around them, MEMORY_MEDIUM; S03: Ha Mac leaning over a carved landscape panel, brush in hand, DETAIL_LOCKED; keyframes CIN_011 S01/S02/S03). quiet_discovery is the composed set's exploration silence ('Khoang lang kham pha': solo flute fragments, single bells, long near-silences, water drops, 60 BPM) -- the sparse quiet of a carving workshop and of a moral reflection ('Net sau khong xoa duoc dieu tot truoc do'); wind_canopy is the wind-through-canopy bed (gusted band noise + leaf rustle) for the open bamboo shelter and the greenery behind S02. The reveal stinger is the scene's only manifest-listed candidate stem (CIN_011_timing_v1.json).

notes: M-F CP2 palette re-mix: the VO take(s) listed under paletteRemix.changes replace the v1 draft take(s). Any v1 note below describing the canonical take's duration or overrun describes the v1 mix only and does not apply to v2.

VO window 12.2-17.8 s is PROPOSED_ANIMATIC_PLACEMENT (only CIN_001_S05 is DECIDED); all 21 windows are approved for DRAFT VO per Goi 30 D1. The window was widened from the uniform 12.5-17.5 s for rate (87 chars at 15.54 chars/s).

VO take runs 12.2-17.792 s: 5.592 s, ending 0.008 s BEFORE the 17.8 s window end -- the take FITS inside its window by 8 ms (no overrun, unlike CIN_005/CIN_006). The take ends 0.208 s before the 18.00 s scene end, so no tail trim at the scene edge. The window, the take and the timing are unchanged.
The CP17 VO take measures -21.50 LUFS (checkpoint 17, re-verified from real bytes this run, vs -22.01 LUFS for the CIN_010 take). VO is kept at unity per the recipe, not normalized.

Ducking depth is measured on the ducked bus against its unducked render (RMS over the full VO window vs a 2 s reference before the window). The full-window method from checkpoint 39 is retained so the depth is comparable across the CIN_003/CIN_005/CIN_007/CIN_008/ CIN_009/CIN_010/CIN_011 mixes (a 2 s slice can understate the cut on cues whose window opening is quiet).
Ambience loop join uses a 1 s acrossfade; loopQA reports the max sample jump at the join against the bed's own 99.9th-percentile jump.
Stinger placement at 6.0 s (S02 start) is PROPOSED pending picture lock, mirroring the CIN_004 reveal at 6.0 s.
